tagline: Pilates and Barre teacher training from the UK's first purpose-built Pilates education centre in Altrincham. Small cohorts, in-person coaching, the full spectrum from contrology and classical to contemporary.
accreditationStatements: Our Mat and Reformer teacher trainings are internationally accredited by ITTAP via the Pilates Method Alliance (PMA).
Our Barre teacher training is the only one in the UK accredited by the Barre Fitness Alliance.
The Pilates Programme is a CIMSPA Training Partner, and our Prenatal and Postpartum CPD is endorsed by CIMSPA.
insuranceNote: You will need teacher insurance before you teach paid classes. Budget for an annual policy from a specialist fitness insurer.
parkingNote: Parking is available nearby. The centre is a short walk from Altrincham train and tram interchange.

providerComparison.heading: What you get with us, and what to check anywhere else
providerComparison.lead: We never name other providers; plenty of them are good. We do think you should know what to ask before you book anywhere, including here.

rows.us: 4 or 5 full in-person days in a small cohort, coached while you teach real bodies.
rows.them: Often larger groups, or mostly online with a short practical.

rows.us: The full spectrum: contrology, classical and contemporary, so you can teach in any studio.
The UK's first purpose-built Pilates education centre, with full apparatus across two floors. Nothing squeezed around a class timetable.
rows.them: A working studio, fitted around its own classes.

rows.us: Included in the one price. No hidden fees.
rows.them: Often charged on top, including resits.

rows.us: HUMAN MOVEMENT, our own anatomy and movement science course, included and sent to you the day you book.
rows.them: Often a separate course or an extra fee.

rows.us: 30 observation, 25 personal study and 25 practice teaching hours, so you walk into your first class industry ready.
Mat and Reformer internationally accredited by ITTAP via the Pilates Method Alliance. Barre is the only UK course accredited by the Barre Fitness Alliance.
rows.them: Check what the accreditation is and who it is from.

rows.us: An actual person on the end of the phone, studio hire at the centre, the jobs board and 10% off further training.
